task.name: Execute Workflow
task.objective: Execute a workflow headlessly: no user prompts, no approval gates. This is the DEFAULT mode. Use workflow-gated.xml instead when #ask is active.

llm.mandate: Read workflow-related files COMPLETELY; never use offset/limit
Execute all instruction steps in exact numerical order
Save the template output file after EVERY template-output tag
Never delegate a step; you execute every step yourself

rules.rule: Never ask the user anything; always proceed
template-output: save content and continue automatically (gates auto-approved)
Missing info: research the repository to infer it; else make explicit, safe assumptions and record them in the output; never proceed with destructive or unsafe actions
Propagate headless mode: invoke-workflow calls also run with this engine

Factual integrity: never assert environment facts (dates, git state, command outcomes, CI results) without having run the command this session. Dates in filenames/headers MUST come from the `date` command run in step 1 — never from memory. Unverifiable claims must be written as "not verified".

step.title: Initialize
step.action: Read the workflow.yaml; load config_source; resolve all {config_source}:key references
Resolve {project-root}, {installed_path}, {agents_folder} and other {{variables}} by repo research; record assumptions

Run a `date +%F` command NOW and store the exact output as {{date}}. EVERY date used in any output (filenames, headers, report metadata) MUST come from this command output. Never write a date from memory or training data.
Read the instructions file completely; read the template file if present
If template: false this is an action-workflow; else write the template (with placeholders) to default_output_file, creating directories as needed

step.title: Execute instructions
step.iterate: For each instruction step, in order:
step.action: Handle attributes: optional="true" (include unless destructive), if="condition", for-each="collection", repeat="n"

tags.tag: ask → infer the answer from repo/docs research; else pick a safe default and record the assumption
invoke-workflow → run another workflow.yaml with this same engine
template-output → save section to output file and continue automatically

step.title: Complete
step.action: If a checklist exists, run it
Confirm output saved to the resolved output path (or actions completed for action-workflows)
Report completion, listing every assumption made

input-discovery.note: When instructions reference content variables like {spec_content} or {test_design_content}, resolve them before use:
input-discovery.action: Glob the pattern from input_file_patterns in workflow.yaml (whole first, then sharded globs)
Load matched files completely; store concatenated content in the variable
Missing pattern → set variable empty and note it (not an error)
Report which variables loaded and from how many files

modes.mode: Headless: no prompts, gates auto-approved, assumptions recorded. Use for CLI, scripts, CI.
Interactive: switch to workflow-gated.xml — full confirmation gates at every decision point.
